progression_rule: This is a starter level. Technique comes first. When every rep looks clean for two sessions of the same day in a row, add 2 reps or 5 seconds to that move. Nothing heavier than the listed kettlebell until Coach Bot reviews. Aim for 2-3 sessions a week, about 25 minutes, with at least a day between. Skip it in a heavy soccer week or if you're tired or unwell. Anything that hurts in a sharp way: stop and tell Mum or Dad. After 12 sessions, level up: Coach Bot writes Level 2 from your logs.

days.name: Day 1 - Bounce and Grip
days.warmup: Play first: 3 min of skipping, tag, or ball taps. Then 10 bodyweight squats, 10 walking lunges, 10 arm circles each way.

exercises.name: Pogo hops
exercises.notes: Quick, quiet, springy hops on the balls of your feet. Stiff ankles, soft knees.

exercises.name: Bodyweight box squat
exercises.notes: Sit back to the bench, chest up, knees track over toes, stand tall.

exercises.name: Dead hang
exercises.notes: You've done 60 s already, so this is easy on purpose. Shoulders pulled down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Kettlebell suitcase carry
exercises.notes: 20 s each hand. Walk tall, don't lean toward the bell.

days.name: Day 2 - Brake and Battle
days.warmup: Play first: 3 min of mirror drill or shuffle tag. Then 10 glute bridges, 6 inchworms, 10 side shuffles each way.

exercises.name: Lateral bound and stick
exercises.notes: 5 each side. Jump sideways off one leg, land on the other and freeze for 2 s, like braking to defend.

exercises.name: Bodyweight reverse lunge
exercises.notes: 6 each leg. Step back long, stay balanced, front knee over the foot.

exercises.name: Incline press-up
exercises.notes: Hands on the bench, body straight like a plank.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.notes: 20 s each side. Strong sides help you hold your ground in a shoulder charge.
